title: An Invoices import file with Line Title and Line Description swapped is rejected
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions, including Settings → Data Import) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Import file {File-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A15.csv) is made from the Invoices import template with one Labor row for customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A15 Fleet), invoice number {Invoice-number-A} (for example ZZWW-A15-1), *Line Title value (for example Replace tie rod) and Line Description value (for example excessive play); but its 16th and 17th columns are swapped, header and value: Line Description first, then *Line Title.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings and, under Data Import, click Invoices.
  2. Upload {File-A} and start the import.
  3. Read the import result message.
  4. Search the imported invoices for {Invoice-number-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the file is rejected with "Invalid file headers provided!".
  • Step 4: no invoice {Invoice-number-A} was imported.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10133 (Story 4, The Imports); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S4-R7, read 13 Oct 2026; no design board exists for this story (tech plan: Story 2 and Story 4 are text-only), labels from the Jira story and tech plan; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), D4 and Phase 2 tests; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R7: “Every other column name, and the required order of columns, is unchanged.”
  • Tech plan Phase 2 tests: “legacy title header placed in slot 16 → rejected”
  • Tech plan FR-018: “A genuinely unrecognized header is still rejected with the importer's existing `Invalid file headers provided!`; the compatibility rule covers exactly the two renamed columns (S4-N1, as reworded by Product 2026-09-24).”
